scope: Replace elementary-edge search complexity semantics; preserve certified graph and diagnostics
invariants: Ordinary degree-2 subdivision preserves macro topology; stop annotations do not define branch nodes
Branch and cycle changes alter macro topology; pure detours may preserve topology and must alter geometry descriptors
Contraction expands exactly to ordered directed road-edge occurrences, preserving multiplicity
Geometric crossings without a traversable graph junction do not create service junctions
Road junctions unused by service are not automatically service branches
Graph leaves are not automatically operational service termini
Skeleton signatures are descriptors, never candidate identity or automatic dedup keys
Parallel macro edges and self-loops survive contraction; pure-cycle canonical origin is not a terminus
Composition checks internal and boundary transitions with sufficient history for via-way restrictions
No reversal of A-to-B evidence to fabricate B-to-A
Shared or repeated road segments retain occurrence and route identity; costs do not silently become unique-edge sums
Missing transition or realization evidence remains UNKNOWN, never certified feasible

alternative_semantics.storage: Lazy compatibility relation or state DAG; no mandatory full Cartesian expansion
alternative_semantics.guaranteed: Intersection over the certified feasible complete realization set for each declared directional service component
alternative_semantics.possible: Union over feasible complete realizations, diagnostic only
alternative_semantics.no_complete_feasible_realization: No vacuous guarantee; report proven infeasible or unresolved
alternative_semantics.unknown_completeness: No exact guarantee claim; certified conservative bounds only with explicit proof
alternative_semantics.legacy_component_intersections: May remain conservative lower bounds after compatibility filtering; do not relabel as exact compatible-set intersection

search_handoff.first_scope: Representation and composition certification on bounded fixtures and real calibration, not territorial search
search_handoff.future_domain: Full frozen reciprocal graph may be reused as a scoped structural domain; it is not all RT017 road walks
search_handoff.time_limit_semantics: RESOURCE_LIMIT_INCOMPLETE, never global completeness or normative stopping
search_handoff.pareto: Only separately certified supported objectives, no weights; previous reductions invalid when objectives change

real_calibration.legacy_stop_ids: Calibration-only; never silently promoted to the frozen 35-stop candidate universe
real_calibration.spacing_semantics: Geodesic inter-stop distance, not routed road spacing
real_calibration.required_completion: Use certified shape/map match or exact road paths with explicit mapping uncertainty; if absent leave physical calibration open

upstream_reuse.RT017: Keep frozen directed graph, epoch and restriction evidence; contraction optional and transition preserving
upstream_reuse.RT019_RT023: Keep primitive discovery and directional realizations; prove continuity at composition boundaries and completeness only within admitted corpus
upstream_reuse.RT028: Reuse matrix unchanged for same certified stops and population; new stops need a separately certified matrix extension
upstream_reuse.RT030: Authoritative attachment/provenance for frozen stops and certified realizations; generic new-carrier adapter needs separate tests/certification
upstream_reuse.population: Preserve frozen atomic population and ISTAT identity
upstream_reuse.municipal_OD: Context only; no route/passenger allocation or demand-weighted GJT inferred
upstream_reuse.RT029: Preserve complete-through-E6 diagnostic and objective-specific Pareto
upstream_reuse.RT031: Reuse existing contraction; Hamiltonian witnesses are structural existence evidence only
